activities.name: Shanghai Museum — People’s Square
activities.schedule: Tue–Sun 09:00–17:00; last entry 15:00. Closed Monday except national holidays.
activities.exception: The People’s Square visitor page says the current “On Top of the World Tree” exhibition runs 2026-07-09–2027-11-14 and no other exhibitions are hosted there during that run. The linked Aug 25, 2025 official notice says individual visitors generally do not need reservations and lists last entry at 16:00; the newer visitor page lists last entry at 15:00 and provides booking guidance. These official pages conflict. Confirm the 2027 date’s last-entry/reservation rule and any exhibition ticket before visiting. Closed Mondays Feb 15 and 22 under normal rules.
